note: Every entry carries both `id` and `finding` with the same value: the record shape the launch message names uses `id`, tools/check_ceremony.py reads `finding`.
method: Nine findings, all applied, none declined. No definition_of_done field was touched in any of the three skills: all three were measured this hour by tools/measure.py and the review reproduced each criterion, breakage target and expected output verbatim. Restatements of an xc- skill's wiring (R62B-005, R62B-006, R62B-007) were fixed by a one-clause pointer naming the owning skill at the head of the row's why, never by rewording the restated rule. For the four restate-and-extend rows (R62B-001..004) a split into an origin=proposed row was not available: each of the three skills sits at exactly 6/20 rows proposed = 30.0 percent by tools/validate_skills.py's own rows_of, so any split or in-place proposed marking would have pushed the skill over 30 percent. The extension was therefore deleted in each case: the restated half became a one-clause pointer naming compose-improvement-loop or build-evidence-record as owner, and the row was re-cited to a record whose quote supports what is left. Proposed share after: 30.0 percent on all three, unchanged. The two unsupported rows leaning on X-end-to-end-066 (search-only, read=null) were re-cited to records that carry the specific claim; X-end-to-end-066 is no longer cited by any of the three skills.
